premises: Lattice distortion in MPEAs elevates vacancy formation energy and Al migration barriers, suppressing Al diffusion.
Suppressed Al diffusion reduces thermally grown oxide (TGO) growth rate and spallation.
Rapid formation of a continuous protective Al2O3 scale occurs via selective oxidation of aluminum.
The dual mechanism (scale formation + diffusion suppression) governs oxidation resistance at 1200°C.
Higher lattice distortion leads to significantly lower TGO growth rates (e.g., ~59% reduction) compared to conventional alloys.
